description.en: A simple no-bake dessert where whipped topping is shaped into clouds in dessert glasses, then filled with instant pudding and chilled.
description.he: קינוח פשוט ללא אפייה, בו קצפת מעוצבת בצורת עננים בכוסות קינוח, ממולאת בפודינג אינסטנט ומצוננת.

en: Divide whipped topping into 6 dessert glasses.
Make a depression and spread up the sides.
he: חלקו את הקצפת ל-6 כוסות קינוח.
צרו שקע במרכז ומרחו כלפי מעלה על הדפנות.

ocrRawText:
Pudding In A Cloud
1 4oz container Cool Whip
1 Pkg instant pudding -
       any flavor
2 cups cold milk
Divot whipped topping into 6
dessert glasses - make a
depression & spread up the sides
Prepare pudding with milk -
spoon into glasses
Chill
rankingReason: Result B is more coherent and accurate. It correctly identifies 'Cool Whip' (a real product) instead of the ambiguous 'tea whip', captures the actual recipe technique of shaping whipped topping into clouds with a depression, and includes all essential ingredients. The instructions are clearer and more practical. Result A invents an ingredient ('tea whip'), infers boiling water that may not be in the original, and describes a less sensible technique of beating everything together. Result B's OCR text is also more plausible as a handwriting transcription, and the Hebrew translation is more natural.
